t: Introduction and overview — Des Moines-class Cruiser
name: Introduction and overview — Des Moines-class Cruiser — ship record
title: Introduction and overview — Des Moines-class Cruiser
description: Introduction and overview of the Des Moines-class Cruiser: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The Des Moines class — three ships — were the ultimate gun cruisers: 21,500 tons with nine 8-inch/55 auto-loading guns firing 10 rounds per minute per barrel, the fastest-firing heavy guns ever put to sea. They served through Korea, Vietnam, and the Cold War; Newport is a museum ship candidate legacy. Baseline facts: U.S. heavy cruiser; 3 built; auto-loading 8-inch guns; fastest-firing heavy guns ever..

title: Comparison with contemporaries — Des Moines-class Cruiser
description: Comparison with contemporaries of the Des Moines-class Cruiser: How the class compared with rival navies' ships. The Des Moines class — three ships — were the ultimate gun cruisers: 21,500 tons with nine 8-inch/55 auto-loading guns firing 10 rounds per minute per barrel, the fastest-firing heavy guns ever put to sea. They served through Korea, Vietnam, and the Cold War; Newport is a museum ship candidate legacy. Baseline facts: U.S. heavy cruiser; 3 built; auto-loading 8-inch guns; fastest-firing heavy guns ever..
